modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Tape winder

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
bring necessary tools like knife to the shift
enquire with the previous shift winder man regarding the issues like winder problem, cheese build defect, tape fibrillation etc.
check the running efficiency of the winder
check the condition of the running oriented tapes, winder speed, Line speed etc.
check the running bobbin package for winding defects like Slippage etc.

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to Tape winder

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming winder man in a proper manner & get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot
check the cleanliness of the machines & other work areas
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / fabric/ any other material is under the machines or in the other work areas
question the previous shift operator for any deviation in the above and should bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior as well that of the previous shift as well
convey instruction to the incoming shift operator if any
report to his/ her shift superiors in case of absenteeism of incoming shift operator
report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/ her shift

modules.module_title: Ensure proper running of the Tape plant winding unit

pcs.pc_description: pull tapes from final godet rollers
take the tapes to respective bobbins on individual winders either manually or through air gun
set tension knob in winder according to Denier
set the winding parameters like speed, Bobbin diameter at control panel
attend the tape breakage by tiny spiral knot
cut the back winding immediately on the godets to reduce the tape breakage
correct the tape winding if observed more fibrillation on the tape, double tape etc
doff and replace cheese pipe/ tube reached once specified diameter
clean the winding machine & work area
collect the Tape waste at winding area in respective waste bag
ensure that all winders are working properly
ensure correct quality of tapes are properly Stacked/stored.
ensure that no raw material/ cloth/ spare/ tool / any other material is thrown under/ near the machines or in the other work areas
